title: senecio amplectens var. holmii
intro: Senecio amplectens var. holmii, commonly known as the Blue Mountain Groundsel, is a plant species within the daisy family native to New Zealand. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Senecio amplectens var. holmii include acting as a vasodilator, which can help to lower blood pressure, and exhibiting antispasmodic properties to relieve muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
